description: This file defines the ProxyMethodDescription class, which models the description of an invokable method on a proxy interface within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes details about method parameters, type parameters, generated invokable descriptions, and code generation helpers.

classes.name: ProxyMethodDescription
classes.description: Models an invokable method on a proxy interface, including its parameters, type arguments, and code-generation details.
